cause: Checkout-specific PID locks admitted simultaneous gate bodies in separate worktrees and TMPDIR values.
impact: Fixed host-wide flock supervisor; lightweight targeted suites pass. Old checkouts still need manual exclusion. Full gate deferred to final integration.
lesson: Use one stable lock inode and retain ownership through child shutdown; metadata PIDs are not authority.

cause: The context provider had 5445 lines across registration, data, model, workflow and projection responsibilities.
impact: Facade and all extracted modules under 2000 lines; 145 affected tests passed; 120 definitions unchanged apart from import relocation.

cause: Generic graph node identifiers were included in the family literal ratchet.
impact: Tag and current checkout reproduce 119 minus 45 generic node identifiers equals 74. No implementation reduction claimed.
lesson: Correct measurement separately before reducing shared family dispatch; retain unknown family identifiers and the same scanned paths.

cause: Manual operations and reports must run through shared deterministic services without a model provider.
